claim_summary: Compares Aureline against a named editor on the first-useful-edit save-conflict task with full disclosure.

config_knobs.name: reps
config_knobs.note: Both sides run 50 reps after a 5-rep warmup on the same corpus revision.

config_knobs.name: save_conflict_mode
config_knobs.note: Identical save-conflict scenario applied to both sides.

environment.power_thermal_posture: Both sides captured under AC-balanced power with verified thermal headroom; no throttling observed.
environment.calibration_drift_note: No calibration-rule-set change or lab-image revision bump since the bound baseline was frozen.
environment.environment_notes: Both products ran on the same frozen reference-lab hardware and lab image back to back; raw machine labels are withheld and only the hardware profile id is published.

comparison.plugin_posture: Compared product ran with no extensions installed to match Aureline's out-of-the-box posture.
comparison.task_parity_note: Identical save-conflict scenario, corpus revision, and acceptance condition applied to both sides; no Aureline-only step was excluded from the competitor run.

caveats: Head-to-head result is bound to the disclosed corpus revision, hardware, and lab image; it does not generalize to other tasks or machine classes.
Compared product has no exact-build identity model, so its toolchain state is disclosed by version string only.

steps: Provision the bound reference-lab hardware profile and lab-image revision and verify thermal headroom.
Resolve the corpus, protected-metrics, and fitness-catalog revisions from their manifests.
Run the Aureline command and the competitor-harness command back to back with the published config knobs.
Compare both retained captures against the published task-parity note and exclusions.

freshness.rule: Head-to-head packs are refreshed or withdrawn when any disclosed comparability axis changes.

notes: Docs/help version-match state for the cited Aureline build is disclosed; a version mismatch withdraws the claim.
